thread:
Lina Gomez: Heads up — candidate Maya Iqbal for L1 SWE. Hybrid interview on Thu Apr 14. Candidate is GMT+5 (Karachi), prefers afternoon their time (which is morning PT). Wants remote loop first, then an in-office quick tour + whiteboard later the same day. Need: visitor badge pre-reg, loaner laptop if necessary, parking pass, and dietary accomodation for lunch. Can someone own logistics?
Mika Chen: I can own scheduling. Maya said she can do 18:00–21:00 GMT+5 (that’s 06:00–09:00 PT) or 21:00–23:00 GMT+5 (09:00–11:00 PT). Which window works for the panel? Also need interviewer availability for a 3-slot loop + 30m tour.
Omar Ruiz: Morning PT slot (09:00–11:00 PT) works best for the team. I can host the in-person whiteboard at 4pm PT if we do the remote interviews earlier. List of interviewers: Omar Ruiz (Hiring Manager), Mia V. (Systems), Kunal S. (Frontend), Priya (PM).
Samir Kaur: @Lina — I can prereg the visitor badge and parking. Need candidate email and full name (as on ID) + phone. Badge will be ready for pickup at security desk (building B) between 3:30–5:30pm. Parking validation: "GUEST-REDWOOD-24" (one-time).
Lina Gomez: Maya’s email: maya.iqbal@example.com, passport name: Maya Iqbal, phone: +92 300 555 1212. Dietary restriction: vegetarian, avoids shellfish. Travel stipend: she asked if we cover train fare from town to office (~$35).
people-ops-bot: Reminder: interview reimbursement policy — local transit under $75: submit receipt to expenses@redwood.com within 30 days. For travel over $75, please pre-approve via people-ops@redwood.com. Official policy: https://intranet.redwood/people-ops/reimbursements (internal link).
Samir Kaur: Got it, I'll prereg the badge using that email. Parking validation code applied. For the laptop loaner — we have a Dell XPS 13 available at desk; loaners are 9am–6pm, please request 24h in advance via asset-requests@redwood.com.
Mika Chen: I created provisional calendar slots and pinged interviewers. Proposed schedule (all times PT): 09:00–09:40 remote loop, 09:50–10:30 remote loop, 10:45–11:15 short culture/career chat, 16:00–16:30 in-office tour + whiteboard. Will send Zoom link + office address.
Omar Ruiz: Looks good. Can we make the first remote loop include a short systems question so we can decide if an on-site whiteboard is necessary? If not, skip the 16:00 slot.
Lina Gomez: Agree. Also note candidate requested a 30min buffer before the tour for commute. We'll keep 16:00 tentative.
Mika Chen: Calendar invites sent to panel and candidate. Zoom link + office directions included. I added a short blurb in the invite: "If you plan to come onsite after remote loop, please RSVP to the in-person tour in the invite so we can confirm badge pickup."
Samir Kaur: Badge prereg done. Visitor QR sent to maya.iqbal@example.com. Parking code in invite.
Lina Gomez: Thanks team. Action items: Mika — confirm interviewer RSVPs and finalize invites (by EOD Wed). Samir — confirm desk will hold loaner laptop if requested (by EOD Wed). Omar — prepare a 15m systems screening question for first loop.
Mika Chen: Will do. Ping me if anyone needs the calendar text snippet.
Lina Gomez: FYI — candidate asked about reimbursement timeline; I quoted the people-ops-bot policy. She’s happy with that.
Mika Chen: Confirmed — candidate acknowledged invite and vegetarian lunch note :thumbsup: 
people-ops-bot: Note added to candidate record: "Maya Iqbal — hybrid, vegetarian, needs badge prereg + possible laptop loaner. Reimbursement instructions emailed."
